title: Senior Administrator, Systems
description:
**Title:**  

Senior Administrator, Systems
  

  

**Position Summary**

The Senior Systems Administrator is responsible for overseeing and providing the installation, maintenance, support and enhancement to the Company computing infrastructure. Areas of responsibility include Windows and Linux Operating Systems , Active Directory , Azure/Entra, Office365, VMWare, Backup and Cloud technologies. The Senior Systems Administrator recommends technology decisions to Management and directs operational processes to Systems Administrators for the ICU Medical Global Computing environment.


**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities**

* Create the Architecture; implement, configure, and support all enterprise computing systems globally.
* Create standards and documentation for the Global computing environments.
* Participate in creating and following the directives in the Infrastructure Strategic plan.
* Adhere to all Service Level Agreements established with the user community.
* Create reports and establish operational guidelines for the Global Computing Environments.
* Create automated monitoring to alert Systems Administrators and Service Desk staff of disruptions of service.
* Participate in vendor management under the direction of the department manager.
* Architect, implement, and support virtual and standalone server and storage solutions.
* Benchmark, evaluate and make recommendations for the selection of server and storage management software and hardware products.
* Develop and implement business continuity practices for server and storage management.
* Monitor server and storage performance, diagnose server issues, and perform emergency and scheduled maintenance.
* Provide support to operations relating to server and storage administration problems.
* Maintain server and storage configurations to provide performance monitoring/tuning of enterprise environments.
* Keep the Information Systems staff and customers informed of the status and resolution of issues; update the Service Desk software with resolutions and status.
* Participate in strategic initiatives by performing technical project activities.
* Evaluate server system and storage upgrades and management software patches.
* Prepare monthly status reports (or implement web\-based reports) quantitatively reporting server and storage capacity, performance and uptime.
* Responsible for securing server and storage resources including password maintenance, new user logon and setup, and data protection procedures.
* Create and maintain automated systems and procedures for storage and server operations.
* Assist Service Desk staff in streamlining daily operations.
* Coordinate with user community scheduling times and user procedures necessary for server and storage system upgrades and/or maintenance.
* Work to minimize downtime impact on users through accurate planning of scheduled downtimes and quick problem resolution for unscheduled downtimes.
* Follow the established standards for writing and documenting projects and server and storage configurations.
* Contribute to the development of new standards and/or the modification of existing standards.
* Participate in the 24/7 department on\-call program.
* Work on special assignments as they arise.

**Knowledge \& Skills**

* Strong knowledge of Microsoft Operating Systems
* Strong knowledge of Office 365 environments
* Experience with PowerShell and using scripting to automate configuration management
* Experience with automation platforms such as SCORCH, MoveIT Automate, VMWare Orchestrator
* Experience with Azure cloud services
* Experience with DFS, CIFS, and print services
* Experience with VDI technologies. Preferably RDS and Horizon
* Experience with MSSQL and basic MSSQL management functions
* Strong knowledge in supporting enterprise backup solutions and troubleshooting backup issues
* Strong knowledge of data center technologies; Virtualization, Storage, Servers
* Understanding or experience supporting .Net application servers
* Knowledge of budget reductions, standardized processes, and operational automation.
* Strong customer service skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Excellent collaboration skills and able to work in a team environment
* Able to work quickly and effectively under pressure and to efficiently handle multiple priorities simultaneously

**Minimum Qualifications, Education \& Experience**

* Must be at least 18 years of age
* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related IT field
* Minimum 7 years of experience in server/user administration, virtualization and storage in a global enterprise environment
* Microsoft certification preferred
* Strong experience in virtual/physical server and storage technologies
* Experience in developing and implementing business continuity and disaster recovery practices
* Experience in data backup technologies
* Experience planning and leading global small to medium scale server related projects

**Work Environment**

* This is largely a sedentary role.
* This job operates in a professional office environment and routinely uses standard office equipment.
* Typically requires travel less than 15% of the time.

title: Test Architect
description:
##### **Project description**

We are seeking an experienced Test Architect to lead the end\-to\-end test strategy across the domain, embedding quality early in the software development lifecycle through shift\-left practices and leveraging AI to enhance and accelerate testing outcomes. This senior engineering leadership role requires the successful candidate to serve as the technical authority on test automation, quality engineering, and test strategy, establishing standards for designing, measuring, and delivering quality across teams.


##### **Responsibilities**


Define and own the domain\-wide test strategy covering functional, integration, regression, and end\-to\-end testing, ensuring alignment with business objectives, engineering practices, and release goals.


Drive shift\-left quality practices by embedding testing into design and development phases to detect, prevent, and resolve defects early, reducing change costs and delivery risks.


Lead the adoption and application of AI throughout the test lifecycle, including AI\-assisted test generation, coverage analysis, specification\-driven test development, automated code review, and intelligent test prioritization.


Establish and enforce standards for test automation frameworks, tooling selection, reusable test assets, and test data strategy to ensure consistency, maintainability, and scalability across the domain.


Implement and maintain quality gates, coverage targets, and measurable test\-effectiveness metrics, such as defect escape rate, test cycle time, and automation coverage, to provide clear visibility into quality status.


Coach and mentor engineers and test specialists across teams, enhancing test engineering capabilities and serving as the technical escalation point for complex quality issues.


Collaborate with architecture leads, delivery leads, and product owners to align testing approaches with CI/CD pipelines, engineering standards, and release schedules.


Continuously assess and adapt the test strategy in response to technology developments, platform changes, and emerging best practices in quality engineering and AI\-assisted development.


##### **Skills**


Must have


The role requires extensive expertise in test automation, quality engineering, and test architecture, gained through over 15 years of hands\-on experience at an enterprise scale. The candidate should have a strong background in designing and implementing shift\-left testing strategies that integrate quality controls into continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines.


Hard skills include proficiency with test automation frameworks, specifically Selenium and Playwright, applied to both API and UI testing. The candidate must demonstrate practical experience in utilizing AI and generative AI technologies to enhance engineering and testing workflows, such as AI\-assisted test case creation, specification\-driven testing, intelligent coverage analysis, and automated test review. Additionally, expertise is expected in managing test data strategies, test environments, and service virtualization within complex, multi\-system architectures. The role also involves defining and managing quality gates, coverage metrics, and test\-effectiveness KPIs within agile and DevOps frameworks.


Soft skills entail strong technical leadership capabilities, with proven ability to influence and align engineering, delivery, and architecture teams without direct authority. Effective communication skills are essential for articulating testing strategies, risks, and trade\-offs to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.


Extensive experience in enterprise\-scale test automation and quality engineering


Design and implementation of shift\-left testing in CI/CD pipelines


Application of AI and generative AI in testing workflows


Expertise in Selenium and Playwright for API and UI automation


Management of test data, environments, and service virtualization in complex systems


Definition and operation of quality gates, metrics, and KPIs in agile/DevOps contexts


Proven technical leadership influencing cross\-functional teams


Clear communication of technical strategies and risk management to diverse audiences

title: Java Telecom Lead -OpenCloud Rhino/JAIN SLEE platforms
description:
**Java Telecom Lead \- OpenCloud Rhino/JAIN SLEE platforms**

**Location:** Bangalore, Chennai, Noida, Pune, India

**Workplace Type:** Hybrid

 **About the Role**


We are seeking a highly experienced and motivated Java Telecom Lead/Architect to join our dynamic team. This role is crucial for designing, developing, and implementing cutting\-edge solutions within the telecommunications domain, specifically focusing on real\-time charging and signaling systems. You will be instrumental in leading architectural decisions, mentoring junior developers, and ensuring the successful delivery of complex projects. The ideal candidate will possess a deep understanding of telecom networks, protocols, and a proven track record in Java development with a specialization in Spring Boot and telecom\-specific technologies. This is an exciting opportunity to shape the future of our telecom offerings and contribute to critical infrastructure.

 **Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the architectural design and development of robust, scalable, and high\-performance Java\-based solutions for telecom charging and signaling systems.
* Develop and maintain core components using Java and Spring Boot, ensuring adherence to best practices and coding standards.
* Implement and integrate solutions leveraging OpenCloud Rhino/JAIN SLEE platforms.
* Configure and customize SAP Convergent Charging (SAP CC) to meet specific business requirements.
* Design and implement solutions that effectively utilize the Diameter protocol for communication between network elements.
* Work with SS7/CAPv2/MAP signaling protocols to ensure seamless interoperability and functionality.
* Drive the development and optimization of real\-time telecom charging (OCS) solutions.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including product management, operations, and other engineering groups, to define requirements and deliver solutions.
* Mentor and guide junior developers, fostering a culture of technical excellence and continuous learning.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues in production and development environments.
* Stay abreast of emerging technologies and industry trends in telecommunications and software development.

 **Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* Minimum of 8 years of professional experience in Java development.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Java and Spring Boot framework.
* Proven experience with OpenCloud Rhino and/or JAIN SLEE.
* Extensive experience with SAP Convergent Charging (SAP CC).
* In\-depth knowledge and practical application of the Diameter protocol.
* Solid experience with SS7, CAPv2, and MAP signaling protocols.
* Demonstrated hands\-on experience in real\-time telecom charging (OCS) environments.
* Good understanding of telecommunications networks, signaling flows, and charging architectures.
* Experience in leading technical projects and mentoring teams.
* Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

 **Additional Information**


This role offers a competitive salary, comprehensive benefits package, and opportunities for professional growth within a leading telecommunications technology company. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and collaborative work environment. Successful candidates will have the opportunity to work on challenging projects that impact millions of users globally. The hybrid work model allows for a balance between in\-office collaboration and remote flexibility. We encourage candidates with a passion for telecommunications and a drive for technical innovation to apply.

title: Sr Product Architect(ISG)
description:
Job Summary
  
Sr Product Architect ISG will define and optimize advanced Generative AI and Machine Learning driven product architectures and validation strategies for life sciences research and development solutions ensuring robust verification and validation outcomes in a hybrid work model. The role focuses on scalable design quality excellence and measurable value for customers and society.
  
  

Responsibilities

Define scalable technical architectures that align with ISG product strategy by harmonizing analytics pipelines validation frameworks and deployment approaches for complex scientific workflows.
  
Lead design of model lifecycle processes including data ingestion feature engineering training evaluation and monitoring to ensure consistent performance and traceability of advanced AI solutions.
  
Drive creation of robust validation test execution strategies that cover functional performance usability and compliance aspects for AI enhanced products in regulated life sciences environments.
  
Collaborate closely with cross functional teams including data science software engineering product management and quality to translate scientific requirements into clear system and component architecture specifications.
  
Provide guidance on verification and validation methods tailored to Machine Learning models including test design scenario coverage model robustness assessment and continuous quality monitoring.
  
Optimize architecture for hybrid work delivery by defining modular components standardized interfaces and remote friendly collaboration practices that support distributed teams and efficient iteration.
  
Evaluate and select appropriate AI and data technologies by assessing scalability interoperability security and long term maintainability to uphold enterprise standards and customer expectations.
  
Develop and review detailed architectural documentation including diagrams data flows and validation plans to ensure shared understanding and traceable decision making across the organization.
  
Mentor senior technical contributors in applying best practices for Generative AI solution design model validation and verification workflows to raise overall engineering maturity.
  
Partner with stakeholders to identify opportunities where AI driven automation and intelligent analytics can improve research outcomes reduce manual effort and accelerate innovation for scientific communities.

Champion architecture decisions that enhance societal impact by enabling more accurate experiments faster discovery cycles and trustworthy AI usage in scientific products.
  
  

Qualifications
  
Demonstrate extensive experience in designing and delivering complex product architectures that incorporate Generative AI and Machine Learning capabilities for enterprise scale solutions.
  
Possess strong hands on background in validation test execution including planning test case design coverage analysis and defect management for software and AI components.
  
Show deep familiarity with life sciences research and development verification and validation practices including risk based testing traceability and documentation of scientific systems.

Utilize strong communication and documentation skills to explain complex architectural decisions AI constraints and validation strategies in clear and concise language.
  
Exhibit experience working in hybrid environments by using modern collaboration tools and processes that support effective design reviews and distributed implementation.

description:
At U.S. Bancorp India, we’re on a journey to do our best. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bancorp India gives you a wide, ever\-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.

**Job Description**
-------------------

* Provide **technical leadership and architectural direction** for enterprise digital analytics platforms, including web, mobile, and event‑driven data instrumentation.
* Design and oversee implementation of **scalable, cloud‑native architectures**, supporting real‑time and near‑real‑time data processing.
* Lead and mentor teams of **software engineers**, offering technical guidance through design reviews, implementation standards, and solution evaluations.
* Define and maintain **engineering best practices** for data quality, testing, deployment automation, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Drive a mindset of **continuous improvement within the team**, including initiatives for automation, AI, and modernization.
* Collaborate closely with your U.S.\-based colleagues, product managers, analysts, marketers, and architects and lead your team to **translate business requirements into detailed technical specifications and implementation designs**.
* Remain actively involved in **technical decision‑making**, including reviewing complex implementations, evaluating tools, and resolving advanced data and instrumentation issues.
* Drive **modernization initiatives**, including migration to server‑side tagging, cloud services, automation, and AI/ML‑enabled analytics capabilities.
* Ensure analytics solutions comply with **data governance, privacy, and security standards**, including GDPR, CCPA, and enterprise cybersecurity requirements.
* Provide **technical leadership** within Agile and Kanban delivery models, supporting planning, execution, and continuous improvement.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in **Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, or a closely related technical field**, or equivalent professional experience.
* 6–8\+ years of progressively advanced experience in **software engineering, analytics engineering, or related technical roles**.
* Deep expertise in **digital analytics implementation**, including Adobe Analytics, Tealium, or comparable analytics or tagging platforms.
* Strong development background in **JavaScript, Java, SQL**, and experience with modern cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud).
* Demonstrated ability to **lead technical teams and make independent architectural and engineering decisions** for complex systems.
* Experience implementing automated testing frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, and modern DevOps practices.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to explain **complex technical concepts** to both technical and non‑technical audiences.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience serving as a **technical lead or engineering manager** for teams building large‑scale analytics or data platforms.

description:
At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life\-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R\&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.


**Job Description**
-------------------


This role involves the development and application of engineering practice and knowledge in the following technologies: Design of mechanical systems, devices, equipment and machines; installing and maintaining mechanically functioning equipment; simulating a wide range of interactions and evaluate performance in real world scenarios; and develop prototype for manufacturability, testing and validation.
**Job Description \- Grade Specific**
-------------------------------------


Focus on Mechanical and Physical Engineering. Develops competency in own area of expertise. Shares expertise and provides guidance and support to others. Interprets clients needs. Completes own role independently or with minimum supervision. Identifies problems and relevant issues in straight forward situations and generates solutions. Contributes in teamwork and interacts with customers.

It delivers end\-to\-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, generative AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem.

title: Data Solution Architect
description:
##### **Project description**

We are seeking a Data Solution Architect to design and implement scalable, cloud\-native data solutions across both OLAP (analytical) and OLTP (operational) architectures, applying advanced data management and governance practices within a large\-scale banking environment. This role provides technical leadership on modern data platforms — spanning Data Lakes, Operational Data Stores, real\-time streaming, and Data Mesh — ensuring solutions are secure, performant, cost\-optimised, and aligned with enterprise data strategy. The successful candidate will combine deep data engineering expertise with architectural vision, working across business, data engineering, and analytics teams to deliver data solutions that support both operational excellence and advanced analytics use cases.


##### **Responsibilities**


Design Data Lake and Operational Data Store architectures using cloud\-native technologies to support both analytical (OLAP) and operational (OLTP) workloads, ensuring proper separation, scalability, and performance.


Define and enforce Data Mesh principles for decentralized data ownership and governance, establishing domain\-oriented data products, self\-serve data infrastructure patterns, and federated governance.


Develop conceptual, logical, and physical data models for analytical and operational use cases, ensuring models are well\-documented, fit for purpose, and aligned with enterprise data standards.


Design batch and real\-time data ingestion pipelines using Apache Kafka and other streaming technologies, ensuring reliable, low\-latency data flow from source systems to Data Lakes, ODS, and downstream consumers.


Build and manage scalable ETL/ELT processes for data cleansing, validation, transformation, and enrichment across multiple source systems including core banking, payments, and transaction banking platforms.


Define patterns for data pipeline orchestration, error handling, retry logic, and monitoring to ensure production\-grade reliability and observability.


Utilize AWS services such as S3, Glue, Redshift, Lambda, Kinesis, Airflow, and SageMaker to deliver end\-to\-end cloud\-native data solutions aligned with security, cost optimization, and scalability principles.


Support advanced analytics and machine learning use cases by designing data pipelines and platform capabilities that provide governed, high\-quality data to data science and business intelligence teams.


Implement data quality frameworks incorporating validation, profiling, and anomaly detection to ensure data trustworthiness.


Establish and maintain metadata management and data lineage tracking to provide transparency into data origins, transformations, and usage.


Define data standards, policies, and best practices collaboratively with data owners, compliance, and business stakeholders to align with regulatory and governance frameworks.


Collaborate with data product owners, data engineers, analytics teams, and business stakeholders to understand requirements, define data products, and deliver solutions driving measurable business value.


##### **Skills**


Must have


The role requires extensive expertise in data architecture and engineering within large\-scale enterprise settings, focusing on designing and implementing complex data platforms. The candidate should demonstrate practical knowledge of data lake, Operational Data Store (ODS), and Data Mesh architectures, employing these frameworks to develop robust production environments. Proficiency in crafting and optimizing data pipelines is essential, including batch and real\-time processes for ingestion, cleansing, validation, transformation, and modeling.


Hard skills include a deep understanding of real\-time streaming technologies, particularly Apache Kafka, covering topic design, partitioning, consumer group management, and integration with downstream systems. The candidate must be adept at leveraging AWS data services such as S3, Glue, Airflow, Redshift, Lambda, Kinesis, SageMaker (including SageMaker Unified Studio), and Amazon QuickSight to architect comprehensive cloud\-native data solutions. Strong capabilities in data modeling across conceptual, logical, and physical layers are required, with experience in dimensional and normalized schemas suited for both analytical and operational workloads.


Soft skills involve advanced problem\-solving and analytical abilities to identify and resolve complex data quality issues, pipeline failures, and performance challenges in distributed systems. Effective communication and stakeholder management are critical, enabling collaboration with technical teams, data product owners, business leaders, and governance stakeholders to ensure alignment and successful delivery. Experience within the banking domain, specifically transaction banking in areas such as trade finance, payments, cash management, and supply chain finance, is preferred.


Hard skills:


Expertise in data architecture frameworks and production implementations.


Proficient in real\-time data streaming with Apache Kafka.


Skilled in AWS data service platforms for end\-to\-end cloud\-native solutions.


Strong data modeling across various schema designs and workloads.


Soft skills:


Analytical problem\-solving for complex distributed data systems.


Effective communication and stakeholder engagement.


Domain knowledge in commercial banking transaction services.

description:

title: Solution Architect - Trade Finance
description:
##### **Project description**

We are seeking a Solution Architect with deep Trade Finance domain expertise to define the target\-state architecture and high\-level design for the Trade Finance domain, aligned to business outcomes and the bank's strategic direction. This role spans business, application, data, and technology architecture — owning the end\-to\-end solution design and transformation roadmap, including integration with Payments and Core Banking platforms. The successful candidate will work at the intersection of business strategy and technology execution, translating complex domain requirements into well\-structured architectural solutions and guiding them through stakeholder alignment, impact analysis, and implementation planning.


##### **Responsibilities**


Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, enterprise architects, domain architects, and technical SMEs to gain a comprehensive understanding of the current Trade Finance architecture, including systems landscape, data flows, integration points, and technology stack.


Document the existing architecture thoroughly, identifying pain points, technical debt, capability gaps, operational inefficiencies, and risks that limit business agility or scalability.


Capture and articulate business objectives, strategic drivers, and domain\-specific requirements to inform the target architectural vision.


Define the target architectural strategy for Trade Finance aligned with the organization’s overall business and technology strategies and enterprise architecture guidelines.


Ensure the strategy addresses Trade Finance domain specifics—such as documentary credits, guarantees, collections, supply chain finance, and compliance—and integration with Payments and Core Banking platforms.


Align the strategy with modern architecture principles, including cloud\-native design, API\-first, event\-driven patterns, and data\-centric approaches, while managing legacy system migration challenges.


Define the target solution architecture covering business, application, data, and technology domains.


Design end\-to\-end architectural views and process flows for the full Trade Finance scope, including integration patterns with Payments, Core Banking, regulatory reporting, and external messaging systems.


Develop high\-level design artifacts that clearly communicate the solution to technical teams and business stakeholders.


Document and assess transformation roadmap options for Trade Finance, evaluating feasibility, risk, time\-to\-value, and organizational impact.


Define the recommended end\-to\-end roadmap, outlining capability sequencing, migration phases, and key milestones.


Produce a high\-level implementation roadmap detailing impacts on related domains, dependencies, risks, and assumptions, and secure approval from relevant stakeholders including business leadership, enterprise architecture, domain leads, and delivery teams.


##### **Skills**


Must have


The candidate brings over 15 years of IT experience, including at least 5 years in Solution or Enterprise Architecture roles within banking or financial services. They demonstrate expertise in defining target\-state architecture and high\-level designs encompassing business, application, data, and technology domains.


Hard skills include:


Deep domain knowledge of Trade Finance processes such as documentary credits, guarantees, collections, supply chain finance, trade loans, and compliance requirements like sanctions screening, AML, and KYC.


Strong understanding of Trade Finance integration with Payments infrastructure and Core Banking systems.


Proficiency in cloud\-native architectures, microservices design patterns, REST and event\-driven API design, contract\-first approaches, and various database models including relational, NoSQL, and event sourcing.


Experience in monolith\-to\-microservices migration and addressing legacy system modernization challenges in banking.


Development of architectural artifacts such as solution architecture documentation, high\-level designs, integration views, data flow diagrams, roadmaps, and options analyses.


Soft skills include:


Effective collaboration with diverse stakeholders across functions, domains, and regions.


Strong communication, facilitation, and negotiation abilities to achieve alignment and secure architectural approvals.


Comfort working in ambiguous environments, translating incomplete business requirements into structured architectural options with well\-defined trade\-offs.
